_comment: Trust policy for every Cloudwise role in a customer account.
Replace <CLOUDWISE_AWS_PRINCIPAL_ARN> with the value shown in the Cloudwise
connection screen, and <EXTERNAL_ID> with the External ID Cloudwise generated
for this specific connection. The External ID is per-connection and is shown
Two conditions matter and neither is optional:
sts:ExternalId  defeats the confused-deputy problem. Without it, anyone who
learns this role ARN could induce Cloudwise to assume it.
aws:PrincipalArn is pinned to a single Cloudwise role rather than to the
account root, so a compromised unrelated principal inside
the Cloudwise account cannot assume this role.
